2026-09-20 12:5xZ ops-triage: new root-cause evidence (this sharpens the ask for Tim). The target is not merely misconfigured -- it is IMPOSSIBLE in this install: gateway/config.py's Platform enum has no 'webui' member (23 members: local/telegram/discord/...; verified by reading the enum), and no plugin supplies one (grep for a webui adapter across gateway/platforms/ and plugins/platforms/ returns nothing), while cron/scheduler_delivery.py resolves the target via Platform(platform_name.lower()) and files 'unknown platform' when it raises. So a WebUI-created job (origin.platform=webui) can NEVER deliver, however long it waits. Second half: this profile has no chat platform configured at all -- channel_directory.json lists only homeassistant and email, both empty -- so there is no valid target to point at today. Decision needed from Tim: configure a chat platform (then 'hermes cron edit <id> --deliver <platform>:<chat_id>'), or accept deliver=local (works; matches tc-overnight-watchdog's ok status; reaches nobody). No in-repo fix exists, and silently downgrading to local would hide the failure rather than fix it.
